page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2s.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 352.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 4.4 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 235,149 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 35 Gbps. The instance does not include any graphics processing units (GPUs) or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile presents specific architectural tradeoffs. While the local storage capacity is exceptionally large, it relies on HDD technology rather than solid-state drives (SSDs), which impacts random read and write performance. Additionally, the CPU flags data indicates a lack of advanced vector extensions (AVX, AVX-512), matrix extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES) support. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high storage density per resource unit, making it suitable for sequential, capacity-heavy workloads rather than high-IOPS database operations or compute-intensive vector processing.

This instance is designed for workloads requiring massive storage volume and high sequential throughput. Appropriate use cases include large-scale data warehousing, log processing, distributed file systems, cold data archiving, and big data analytics frameworks that can leverage high-capacity local HDDs alongside 80 dedicated vCPUs.
